h1: 3 BHK, 3.5 BHK & 4 BHK Flats at Kudlu Gate: The Complete Buyer’s Guide for 2026

blocks.text: The Kudlu Gate–Hosur Road micro-market is one of South Bengaluru’s most competitive residential corridors. Between Electronic City to the south, Silk Board to the north, and the HSR Layout belt to the west, this zone sits at the apex of Bengaluru’s professional residential demand.

If you are looking for 3 BHK, 3.5 BHK, or 4 BHK flats near Kudlu Gate, this guide gives you everything you need: what each configuration offers, how to evaluate luxury projects in this corridor, the questions you must ask before booking, and why CKPC Heart of Harmony by CKPC Properties leads the luxury supply here.
Why Kudlu Gate Is Bengaluru’s Top Address for Luxury BHK Buyers

Kudlu Gate on Hosur Main Road is Bengaluru’s most strategically positioned luxury residential address — combining Kudlu Gate Metro Station (Yellow Line) at 400 metres, direct access to Electronic City (4–6 km), Silk Board Junction (5–6 km), and HSR Layout (6 km). Limited luxury supply in the 560068 pin code means genuine 3.5 BHK and 4 BHK options here are genuinely scarce. For the full analysis of why this corridor is one of Bengaluru’s fastest-appreciating residential micro-markets, read our Kudlu Gate residential growth corridor guide .
Understanding the BHK Configurations: 3 vs 3.5 vs 4 — What Is the Real Difference?
Who Is the 3 BHK Buyer at Kudlu Gate?

The 3 BHK buyer in this corridor is typically a senior professional or couple with one or two children, prioritising three independent bedrooms, a spacious living-dining area, proximity to quality schools, and entry into the luxury segment without committing to the 4 BHK price point.

Heart of Harmony’s 3 BHK is particularly compelling because it delivers the same 6-homes-per-floor privacy and exclusivity that other projects reserve for their 4 BHK buyers. Buyers ready to explore availability can see our full page on 3 BHK and 4 BHK apartments for sale in Kudlu Gate .
Who Is the 3.5 BHK Buyer at Kudlu Gate?

The 3.5 BHK has become the most sought-after configuration in Bengaluru’s luxury market since 2020. The additional study or flex room moved from ‘nice to have’ to a daily necessity for a specific buyer profile:

items: A senior IT professional or business owner who works from home 2–3 days a week and needs a dedicated workspace separate from family areas
A family with a live-in parent who needs a private space that is more than a corner of the living room
A buyer who wants future flexibility — the study converts to a nursery, teenage bedroom, or second home office as the family grows

Who Is the 4 BHK Buyer at Kudlu Gate?
The 4 BHK buyer at the top of this corridor’s residential pyramid. Space is not a compromise — it is a statement.

items: A family of five or more, or a joint family requiring true multi-generational living

10 Questions to Ask Before Buying a Luxury Flat Near Kudlu Gate

items: Is the project RERA registered? Demand the number and verify at rera.karnataka.gov.in
What is the carpet area — not the super built-up area — for your chosen configuration?
How many homes are there per floor, and what is the total unit count?
What is the committed possession date as registered under RERA?
Who is the developer, and what is their delivery track record?
What is the all-inclusive cost — BSP plus parking, club membership, deposits, stamp duty, and GST?
What payment plan options are available, and is the project home-loan approved?
What are the specification quality levels — can you see the brands in the specification sheet?
What is the maintenance charge structure post-possession?
What is the current construction stage, and can you visit the site?
